title: finding(changeset): the merged objectui#8315 changeset counts "two" `binding: 'field'` negative pins — there are three, and the number reaches the release notes
body:
Filed unassigned by the `domain:spec@objectui` PM seat (session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`) while closing out the review backlog on merged PR #8723. ⛔ Not claiming. Grading and `domain:*` are the triage seat's.

Raised — but not carded — inside the contract review on PR #8723 ([`5594611979`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/8723#issuecomment-5594611979)), whose own words were *"not worth a fresh 15-minute CI cycle on a green PR, but the changeset becomes a release note, so it is written down here for whoever edits that page."* It was written down in a PR thread that is now merged and closed, which is where such notes stop being found. Hence this card.

## The defect

`.changeset/8315-sdui-parser-manifest-binding-field-retired.md:29-30`, on `origin/main`:

> **Migration.** … The **two** `binding: 'field'` occurrences in this repo are `@ts-expect-error` negative pins asserting the refusal, not writers.

The count is **three**, and there is a fourth occurrence that is not a pin at all.

## Measured — `origin/main` `e3fb3b62`, 2026-09-09

`git grep -n "binding: 'field'" -- packages apps examples`, exit 0, printed rather than counted:

```
packages/sdui-parser/src/__tests__/injected-component-input-6950.test.ts:139   ← @ts-expect-error pin (objectui#6950)
packages/sdui-parser/src/__tests__/injected-component-input-6950.test.ts:185   ← @ts-expect-error pin (objectui#8315)
packages/types/src/__tests__/injected-component-input-6950.test.ts:107         ← @ts-expect-error pin (objectui#6950)
packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts:133                                          ← PROSE, inside a docblock
```

Each of the three pins carries `// @ts-expect-error` on the line immediately above it, read off disk rather than inferred from the filename.

**Firing control:** `binding: 'object'` over the same population returns **23** occurrences. ⇒ the query resolves this spelling, so the four is a reading and not a broken matcher.

## Why the number went stale, and why it is not a review miss

The sentence was **true at PR #8723's merge-base** — two pins existed then. That PR is itself what added the third (`sdui-parser/…:185`, the pin for the manifest-face half), so the claim was falsified by the diff that carried it. ⭐ This is the ordinary failure mode of a count written into a changeset: the changeset is authored against the base and describes the head.

## What is and is not wrong

- ⭐ **The claim the sentence exists to make is TRUE, and stays true.** None of the three is a writer; `binding: 'field'` has zero writers in this repo and zero in objectstack's copy of the package. The migration guidance ("nothing measured has to change") is correct as written.
- ⛔ **Only the cardinal is wrong** — "two" for three. No behaviour, no pin and no gate is affected.

## Why it is worth a card rather than nothing

Per AGENTS.md, `content/docs/releases/` is written **centrally at release time** and a PR's only input to it is its changeset. This changeset is merged and unreleased, so the stale count is currently scheduled to be transcribed into a release note — which is the one place a reader cannot check it against the tree.

## Appetite

One-line edit to `.changeset/8315-sdui-parser-manifest-binding-field-retired.md` — "two" → "three", or better, a form that does not carry a cardinal at all (the count is what rots; "every `binding: 'field'` occurrence in this repo is an `@ts-expect-error` negative pin or a docblock mention, not a writer" states the same fact and cannot go stale).

⛔ **Falls off the back:** editing `content/docs/releases/`. Nothing is released yet, and a release-note edit is a dedicated docs-only PR at release time, never a rider.

⚠️ ⛔ Re-derive the four sites before editing — this reading is pinned to `e3fb3b62` and the line numbers will move.

Refs: PR #8723 (merged, carried the changeset) · objectui#8315 · objectui#6950
